description: Create subtasks (checklist items) for a task. Pass titles as an array — one string per subtask — and each becomes its own record. New subtasks are appended after any that exist.

depends_on.description: Siblings each new subtask waits on

titles.description: Subtask titles, one per array item — e.g. ["Write it", "Test it"]. Always an array, even for a single subtask.

name: subtask_create
